exportCompliance.rationale: The app uses standard Apple platform HTTPS and Keychain cryptography and implements no custom or non-exempt encryption. Reconfirm against the exact candidate.

betaReviewNotes: Green Room is a local-first ensemble conversation app. Rooms, drafts, events, provider selection, and provider-consent records are persisted locally in the app container; provider credentials remain in iOS Keychain. The app has no Green Room account, analytics collector, model proxy, transcript service, or relay. When a tester explicitly consents and sends a prompt, the app transmits the prompt, bounded recent room messages, selected character instructions, model ID, and generation settings directly over HTTPS to the tester-selected fixed BYOK provider; those transmitted content fields may be retained under the provider/account/route terms. No demo account exists. Apple/Kent must approve a non-secret review path and any tester credential arrangement before Beta App Review; no credential is included in this draft.
testerInstructions: Install only the exact owner-approved TestFlight build and confirm version 0.1.0 build 3.
Open Privacy & Data Use before provider setup.
Use only a provider API key you obtained independently and are authorized to use; Green Room does not sell or provide model access.
Select one of the five fixed providers and a valid model, review the named host/content disclosure, and explicitly consent before model listing or generation.
Create or reopen a local room with one to three AI characters, send a bounded prompt, then verify the directed response and relaunch continuity.
Exercise offline existing-room read-only behavior and the credential-removal confirmation. Never paste keys, transcripts, device identifiers, profiles, or raw logs into feedback.
knownLimitations: Alpha software for iPhone only; minimum iOS 18.6. iPad-specific layouts are not supported.
No Green Room account, relay, synchronization, invitations, hosted inference, on-device LLM, voice/video rooms, or push notifications.
Generation requires a separately obtained key for a supported fixed BYOK provider and network access; provider availability, model access, cost, and retention are controlled by that provider.
Offline use is limited to reading existing local rooms; new provider turns fail closed.
Deleting a credential disables new provider requests and removes the current Keychain item after verified readback; it does not delete local rooms or data retained by a provider.
Historical personas are creative educational interpretations, not the actual people or endorsed representatives.
